where: big-demons-baby · Daemon Prince of Khorne · Direct the Slaughter
why: 'Once per battle round' is right (the text opens with it; the app's onceTag adds ', per army' from 'one model from your army with this ability'). 'Aura' is not: GW does not tag this ability Aura (Wahapedia datasheet world-eaters_Daemon-Prince-of-Khorne: 'Direct the Slaughter: Once per battle round, …', no tag, while the same card tags its real auras), and 22.01 says aura abilities 'are tagged with the word Aura'. The 12" is the trigger condition for a CP discount on a Stratagem, not an effect on units within range. The deviations-nr.json entries for Direct the Slaughter (princes x2, big-demons-baby) argue only from New Recruit wording and leave out that GW's own card has no tag.
The text (Wahapedia errata / Thousand Sons Faction Pack) opens 'Once per turn, when you target this unit…'. No range, so no Aura.

GW tags it Aura (Wahapedia 'Malign Presence (Aura)'; New Recruit prints '(Aura)'). The Tyranids Faction Pack 14-10 replaces only its text with 'Once per turn, when your opponent targets a unit … within 12" of this model…', so 'Once per turn' is exact.

where: nidzillas · Hive Tyrant · Will of the Hive Mind
why: 'Once per battle round' is exact (Tyranids Faction Pack 14-10 change text). 'Aura' is not on GW's card: Wahapedia tyranids_Hive-Tyrant prints 'Will of the Hive Mind:' with no tag next to 'Onslaught (Aura, Psychic)', and the pack's new text has none either. It is a CP discount when a unit within 12" is targeted with a Stratagem, the same as Direct the Slaughter. The deviations-nr.json entry (hive-tyrant) is wrong for the same reason.

'Once per turn' is exact. 'Aura' is not on GW's card (Wahapedia tyranids_Norn-Assimilator: 'Harpoon Barbs: Once per turn, when an enemy unit within Engagement Range of this model is selected to Fall Back…', no tag; New Recruit has no tag either). It is a one-off trigger on a unit falling back, not a standing effect over a stated distance. The deviations-nr.json entries (norn-assimilator-synaptoprescience, -2) should go.

turns:{shooting:'opp'} is a derive.js misread. The rule `targeted` (/an attack that targets … that unit/) matches 'each time this model makes an attack that targets that unit', where 'that unit' is the selected ENEMY unit. That sentence is this model's own attacks (any-attack: your Shooting phase and the Fight phase), and the Norn Emissary has 18" Psychic Tendril ranged weapons, so its own Shooting phase is the main use. The objective option (Feel No Pain 5+) adds the opponent's Shooting phase and the Fight phase. Together: shooting in both turns, so no turns override. Command is right (the choice is made at the start of the first battle round, before the Command phase). Moving the old tag to at:'Start of the first battle round' is right. The same misread applies to all four Singular Purpose copies (Norn Emissary and Norn Assimilator, data.js ~2799/2832/2865/2900).
The text opens 'Once per battle, at the start of any phase…' (Wahapedia imperial-knights_Canis-Rex). It selects a unit within 12", which is not an aura, and it is correctly untagged.
The text opens 'Once per turn, when you target this model with a stratagem…' (Wahapedia). No range.

where: purge-goes-the-foe · Belisarius Cawl · Canticles of the Omnissiah
why: 'Aura' comes from the sub-abilities inside the text (Binharic Courage (Aura), granted by Mantra of Discipline, and Shroudpsalm (Aura)). Canticles of the Omnissiah itself is a Command-phase selection and not an aura. Invocation of Machine Vengeance is explicitly not one (the AdMech Faction Pack v1.4 drops its '(Aura)', as deviations-nr.json already notes). GW's card has no tag on Canticles (Wahapedia adeptus-mechanicus_Belisarius-Cawl, Faction Pack change text). Tagging the parent says every canticle is an aura. The text already shows '(Aura)' on the two that are.

Enhancement: right. 'Aura': GW does not tag the enhancement (Wahapedia Cohort Cybernetica: 'Necromechanic 20 pts … TECH-PRIEST model only. Once per battle round, when a saving throw made for a friendly … model within 12" of the bearer is failed, the bearer can use this Enhancement'). It is a once-per-round triggered use, not a standing effect over a range, so the deviations-nr.json entry (tech-priest-enginseer) is wrong. The text's limit 'Once per battle round' is missing from the tag: tag-once only looks at the opening, and here the text opens with the 'TECH-PRIEST model only.' restriction. The app's onceTag strips that restriction, so the chip shows the limit anyway, but the stored label should say it the way the other items now do.
The text opens 'Once per battle, at the start of the Fight phase…' (Wahapedia emperors-children_Lord-Exultant, New Recruit).

New Recruit prints 'Transport Capacity' for the Chaos Rhino (defilers-and-friends.txt l.349-351). The old entry had name and who swapped (name 'Chaos Rhino', who 'Transport'). It now matches the two World Eaters Rhino entries (name 'Transport', tag 'Capacity'). The text is unchanged.

where: woof-woof · War Dog Brigand · Final Howl (Aura)
why: GW names it 'Final Howl (Aura)' (Wahapedia Houndpack Lance enhancements), and it is a standing effect on friendly War Dogs within 6" of the bearer. 'Enhancement · Aura' is exact, and the deviations-nr.json entry for it is right.

The regex matches 'Enhancement' as a whole part of a tag separated by ', ' or ' · ' (it would not match 'Upgrade', and none of the 22 Enhancement tags in data.js has another form). It is used only for the chip in abilityList. The old test (=== 'Enhancement') gave Final Howl and Necromechanic the chip when their tag was plain 'Enhancement', so the screen keeps the chip they already had. The meta line, search sub, ability sheet and Ask text print ab.tag verbatim and are not affected beyond showing the new tag. onceTag still finds a 'Once per …' that is not the first part. Under my Necromechanic fix ('Enhancement · Once per battle round'), isEnhancement still matches.
